Class PreCompressedResources

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.web.router.resource.PreCompressedResources
@Internal public final class PreCompressedResources extends Object
Finds the pre-compressed sibling of a static resource, e.g. app.js.br of app.js, for the content codings a request accepts.

A sibling is at the path of the original with the extension of the coding. In a directory of the file system, it is resolved by the loader of the original, which refuses a path that leaves its base. On the classpath, the sibling is the entry next to the resource, in the same directory or jar, probed at its URL without searching the class loader: whether an entry of a jar or of a native image exists is remembered, as they do not change while the application runs; a file of an exploded classpath is checked for every request, and must be a regular file, not a link.

Since:
5.3.0

  • Method Details

    • acceptable

      public static List<PreCompressedResources.Coding> acceptable(Iterable<String> acceptEncoding)
      The codings of pre-compressed siblings a request accepts, from its Accept-Encoding header values, the preferred first: by weight, then br, zstd, gzip. A coding is left out if its weight is zero, if neither it nor * is listed, or if the request explicitly gives identity a higher weight.
      Parameters:
      acceptEncoding - The values of the Accept-Encoding header
      Returns:
      The acceptable codings, the preferred first; empty to serve the resource as it is

    • find

      public @Nullable PreCompressedResources.Sibling find(StaticResourceResolver.ResolvedResource original, List<PreCompressedResources.Coding> codings, Predicate<? super StaticResourceResolver.ResolvedResource> acceptable)
      Finds the pre-compressed sibling of a resource for the first of the given codings that has one.
      Parameters:
      original - The resource
      codings - The codings, the preferred first, see acceptable(Iterable)
      acceptable - Whether a resource of the loader is served; a sibling it refuses is a miss
      Returns:
      The sibling and its coding, or null if no coding has one
